layers.message: Record audit log export context, scope, design, and plan
Add CSV serializer for audit log entries
Route JSON export change back to scoping

graderOnly: The approved JSON change is recorded in Active Work.Request (CSV or JSON, same filters and permissions), in Handoff (USER_REWORK from DEVELOPING, FailureType SCOPING), and in Recovery Frame 1's Reason; the scope file itself still describes CSV only.

The scope's Non-goals list 'Export formats other than CSV' and its Goal mentions only CSV; the approved change invalidates both, while AC-001 (CSV download) and AC-002 (same filters and permissions) keep their meaning.

The completed technical design at .standards/docs/specs/export-audit-log-20260924T090000Z-3c9e5b21.md says the export endpoint produces CSV only and ignores any other query key, so the new JSON outcome invalidates it; it mentions no acceptance identifier other than AC-001 and AC-002.
Project context in .standards/CONTEXT.md is valid for the active cycle; the JSON change needs no new audit and no PROJECT_CONTEXT failure is warranted.

Development is IN_PROGRESS: DEV-001 (CSV serializer in src/export/csv.js) is DONE and DEV-002 (export route) is PENDING; the plan's Plan Notes hold Suspended Assignment 1 for Frame 1. ResumeAt DEVELOPING is the interrupted state itself, so the rerun runs only through ARCHITECTING.
The next unused acceptance identifier in the scope is AC-003.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): small Node ESM audit console backend (audit log store and filters, admin-only permission, filtered view handler, node:test suites) plus two unmarked product notes under docs/scope, one of which (export-audit-log.md) the cycle later reuses as its scope. 60-records: Auditor CONTEXT.md, the scope rewritten in template form with AC-001 (CSV download) and AC-002 (same filters and permissions) and a Non-goal excluding formats other than CSV, a STANDARDS-owned CSV-only technical design, an APPROVED AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION plan, STATE at DEVELOPING. 70-serializer: src/export/csv.js and the plan with DEV-001 DONE and self-check evidence. 80-rework: STATE at SCOPING with Request updated to CSV or JSON, Handoff USER_REWORK from DEVELOPING FailureType SCOPING, Frame 1 (From DEVELOPING, Owner SCOPING, ResumeAt DEVELOPING, RerunThrough NONE); the plan gains Suspended Assignment 1 for that frame so the scoped Developer recovery is recoverable. The approved change lives in Active Work.Request, Handoff.Reason, and the frame Reason. Expected end state: scope with a new AC-003 (or later), WorkflowState ARCHITECTING, FORWARD from SCOPING, frame kept with RerunThrough ARCHITECTING; the turn-end check passes because the design is not held to coverage until Architect hands off.
